run_job: run a Docker image with a command on Hugging Face Hub infrastructure
list_jobs: list running jobs on Hugging Face Hub with optional filters and formatting
stream_job_logs: stream logs from a running or completed job by job ID
schedule_job: schedule a recurring job with a cron expression or keyword on Hugging Face Hub
run_uv_script: run a UV Python script with inline dependencies on Hugging Face Hub infrastructure
